checked.claim: Overruling, after the floor has closed, the newest Objection of a Testimony or the Closing writes againAfterOverrule with the speaker's leftAtObjection, so the console offers 'Open the debate again (n s left)' for a debate that never ran.

TRIAL_NEXT_STEPS answers openAgain at 198 when no vote or verdict row holds.
